name: Côte d'Ivoire: cocoa (verification layer on the national system)
_whisp_note: Whisp has Ivorian national layers: nCI_Forest_bnetd_2020 and nCI_Cocoa_bnetd (https://github.com/forestdatapartnership/whisp/blob/main/layers_description.md). Requested with nationalCodes ['ci'].

cocoa._source: 462 kg/ha average for Côte d'Ivoire, 2023/24 season (Barry Callebaut/Agri-Logic White Paper 2026, p.11, sample incl. 1,340 Ivorian farmers: https://www.barry-callebaut.com/system/files/2026-02/Barry%20Callebaut%20White%20Paper%202026_%20Harvesting%20insights_what%20drives%20farmer%20prosperity.pdf). Threshold = 2x average, a review trigger, not proof: well-managed farms can approach it.

a: Côte d'Ivoire is standard risk (not listed in Impl. Reg. 2025/1093): full due diligence, no Art 13 simplification.
c: Indigenous peoples overlay for Côte d'Ivoire: no source found yet. To be assessed by the operator.
d: Only required where an overlap with indigenous peoples' land exists. Not assessed yet.
e: No claims recorded. Source for claims over the area: not found yet.
f: Prevalence of deforestation in the production area: to be assessed by the operator with sourced national figures (none attached yet). Whisp results per plot are in the Art 9 file.
h: Requires narrative assessment. Note the EFI 2026 finding: excluding a farm on paper does not keep its cocoa out of the physical chain. EUDR-Snap's producer-card volume check is the mitigation offered; operator to sign off.
g: Sales come from cooperative purchase records keyed by producer card (entered from the records; no AI document reading for Côte d'Ivoire yet). Reviewer decisions are logged with name and timestamp.
i: Sales are recorded per producer card, not per plot. Volumes are pooled per card, crop and season over all the card's plots before the plausibility check.
